name: Nocturne Island
summary:
Nocturne Island is a set of four small daily puzzles played on a pixel-art island at night. A new set appears every day, and every player gets the same one, so results can be compared with everyone else who played that day. Each puzzle is opened from a building on the island map and is scored out of 100.

RANGE is a number trivia quiz answered with ranges instead of single numbers: a narrower range that still contains the answer scores more, and a miss scores nothing. In TANDEM, every arrow move pushes two pieces at once across a walled grid, and full points need the shortest route. CARGO is a packing puzzle about fitting fixed-shape pieces into a ship's hold, and in BLOOM six water pumps have to be set so that each flower bed gets exactly the water it needs.
